beats.hook: I walked in on my boyfriend kissing someone else — and I recognized her immediately. It was my sister.
beats.the_wrong: They'd been meeting up for three months. Right under my nose. My sister had a key to my apartment.
beats.the_plan: I didn't cry. I didn't confront them. I had something better in mind — because both of them had something coming up they'd been counting on me for.
beats.the_execution: My sister's birthday dinner. I'd been planning it for six weeks — the reservation, the cake, the whole thing. I canceled every single piece of it the morning of, without saying a word. Then I called our mom. I told her everything. Calmly. Over speakerphone — with my sister sitting right there at the table, waiting for a party that was never going to happen.
beats.the_satisfaction: My sister's face went completely white. My boyfriend tried to explain. My mom just said — "Get out of her house." Both of them left with nothing. I changed my locks that same night. Would you have done it differently — or did they deserve every second of it?
beats.cta: Drop a comment — because there's a part two, and it involves my mom finding something on my sister's phone that none of us saw coming.
